home.heroSubtitle: Live schedules, services, and daily announcements for St. Mary's Community Services. This is the digital bulletin site, not the main SMCS website.

about.title: About Us
about.p1: Individuals and families who are living in poverty or experiencing homelessness need provisions to get through today, services that open doors for a stable tomorrow, and caring support that gives them hope for a brighter future.
about.p2: For nearly seven decades the Stockton community has supported St. Mary's Community Services through financial gifts, partnerships, volunteer hours and donations, sustaining our efforts to help individuals in vulnerable circumstances meet their daily challenges and rebuild their lives.

services.title: Our Services
services.intro: There are as many reasons why people experience homelessness as there are people who are homeless. Our caring staff provides individualized attention to guests to not only ensure that they have daily provisions, but to also support and connect them with services that can lead to healthier lives and permanent housing.
services.fullListBefore: Learn more about our full list of services
